summary: App builds (0 errors) and launches, but the NavigationView content Frame is blank on every scenario. Root cause: SelectionChanged casts the MenuItemsSource-bound data item (Scenario) to NavigationViewItem, which fails silently so ScenarioFrame.Navigate is never called. Single generalizable skill-defect: missing NavigationView+Frame wiring pattern for the SDK-sample idiom.
